searchText: Would it be worth asking the gaming community to join mining just for that one day to mitigate possible problems with a dropping hashrate? I have no idea whether we could gather enough hash power to make a difference though. Maybe we could give them some incentive, like doing a lottery with some heavy gaming rigs? <dankrad> don't they hate us for stealing all their graphics cards? ;) Award a brand new 3090 for each block mined in the 24 hours leading up to the merge 🙂

excerpts.content:
Would it be worth asking the gaming community to join mining just for that one day to mitigate possible problems with a dropping hashrate? I have no idea whether we could gather enough hash power to make a difference though.

Maybe we could give them some incentive, like doing a lottery with some heavy gaming rigs?
